decisive_items: Dermis permeated by irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes and lined by plump oval cells
Cells stained positively with CD31 and were negative for CK5
rapid growth and extension followed by central ulceration and bleeding
response.rationale: Clinical presentation of a rapidly enlarging purpuric plaque with ulceration, combined with histopathology showing vascular slitlike spaces and CD31 positivity with CK5 negativity, is characteristic of angiosarcoma.
